# Status Workflow

## Purpose
Maintain clear project status visibility for all stakeholders.

## Status Levels

### Project Health
- 🟢 **Green**: On track, no blockers
- 🟡 **Yellow**: Minor delays, manageable risks
- 🔴 **Red**: Significant delays, critical blockers

### Feature Status
- **Backlog**: Prioritized, not started
- **Ready**: Specs complete, ready for dev
- **In Progress**: Active development
- **Review**: Code review / QA
- **Done**: Deployed to production
- **Blocked**: Waiting on dependency

## Communication

### Daily
- Standup: 15 min sync
- Blocker escalation
- Quick decisions

### Weekly
- Team sync: Progress, risks, decisions
- Stakeholder update: High-level summary
- Metrics review

### Bi-weekly/Monthly
- Sprint review + retro
- Stakeholder demo
- Roadmap alignment

## Documentation

### Living Documents
- Project README (current status)
- Architecture decision log
- Risk register
- Dependency tracker

### Status Reports
- Sprint summary (end of sprint)
- Monthly stakeholder report
- Quarterly business review

## Tools
- Project board (real-time)
- Status page (external)
- Incident status (during outages)
- Slack/Teams channels
